probability_meaning: Static Telco proxy-model probability; not a calibrated future Azure churn probability.
rule_basis: Prespecified operational tiers: retain frozen positive decision at p>=0.30; p<0.10 identifies a lower-priority review band. No data-driven threshold search or capacity/cost optimality claim.

actions.low: 常规维护：观察使用与服务反馈；低分不代表不会流失。
actions.medium: 关注复核：核对近期体验、费用与合同背景，确认是否需要联系。
actions.high: 优先人工复核：结合客户背景与贡献解释确定联系顺序；不自动承诺优惠。
